description: Squarespace provides Commerce APIs that let developers manage products, orders, inventory, discounts, contacts, analytics, transactions, and webhooks via authenticated HTTP requests.

evidence.claim: Squarespace supports authentication via API key or OAuth access token
Developers can generate an API key or start the OAuth process themselves
Squarespace Commerce APIs are accessed via HTTPS REST requests using curl syntax
Squarespace offers a broad set of Commerce APIs covering Forms, Inventory, Orders, Products, Contacts, Discounts, Webhook Subscriptions, Profiles, Transactions, and Analytics
Integrations can be built by generating an API key or OAuth client and making HTTPS requests, indicating possible buildability
MCP status is not mentioned in the provided documentation
